title: Order together
headline: Order *together*
sub: One basket from one business: everyone adds, one person places it.

bridge.en: Lunch is placed. One thing left: keeping it safe.
bridge.pcm: The lunch don go. One thing remain: keep am safe.

flow.action: Turns in his chair to two colleagues out of shot (only their hands and elbows visible), laughing, phone raised
flow.setting: Tobi's desk at a logistics office in Yaba, Lagos: a laptop, a paper cup of zobo, a window on the street

flow.action: Sets three paper lunch bags on the desk with a pleased nod
flow.setting: Tobi's desk at a logistics office in Yaba, Lagos: a laptop, a paper cup of zobo, a window on the street

en: Lunch at the office? Open the Office lunch group.
A basket card appears. Tap Open basket.
It is empty. Tap Add my items.
Add one jollof rice and one zobo.
Tap Put my two in the basket.
Bola and Kemi add theirs on their phones.
You hold the basket. Choose Pick-up.
When all have added, tap Close the basket.
If the business takes payment here, choose who pays.
Or choose I'll pay all. Here, each pays their own.
The order is placed. Each sees their own share.
